name: Disposable vape
description: A sealed nicotine vape. Calms the nerves. Habit-forming. Thrown away when empty.
notes: The item id describes the thing; the model id keeps the reference's. The reference's 1 g is its smallest unit; the player picks up the whole sealed device, so the row carries about 12 g and CHECK MASS is that choice. plastic-clear-red stands in for the lit tip. Nicotine and addiction have no content fields yet.

name: Bottle of eye drops
description: Sterile saline drops. Soothes dry eyes and rinses grit out of them.
notes: A liquid, so the item is the whole 15 ml squeeze bottle and the row carries 22 g with it; CHECK MASS and CHECK VOLUME are that choice, against the reference's single drop of 3 g and 1 ml. Eye irritation has no content field yet.

name: Flu shot
description: A sealed prefilled vaccine syringe. Guards against one season's flu.
notes: Drawn as the syringe on the paper backing of its peel pack, as it is found. CHECK VOLUME is the padding of a carried volume around a thin syringe. glass-clear barrel shows the dose only in the game. The epinephrine autoinjector shares this model as a variant; a pen-shaped injector would read better and could get its own row later. Immunity has no content field yet.

name: Hand-rolled cigarette
description: A thin cigarette rolled by hand. Calms the nerves and dulls hunger. Habit-forming. Needs a light.
notes: The model is the single cigarette, since the player rolls and carries them one at a time; stack 10 lets them carry a handful. Made by the player rather than found, so usage is empty. Its 8 mm thickness is four voxels at 2 mm grain, so the taper to the twisted end is coarse.

name: Bag of heroin
description: A strong opioid. Kills pain and brings a heavy calm. Overdose is easy. Extremely addictive.
notes: Not skipped as loose powder: it is found in a folded glassine stamp bag, so the model is the bag. wax-ivory stands in for glassine, paperboard-tan for the off-white powder. Residential stands in for street loot, as for cocaine.

name: Syringe of cannabis oil
description: Golden cannabis distillate in a dosing syringe. Calms the nerves and dulls pain. Can fill a refillable vape.
notes: A liquid, so the item is the whole 1 ml glass syringe and the row carries 6 g with it, though the reference counts ten 0.3 g units; the look step marks that as per unit. fuel-amber stands in for the oil; the glass barrel shows it in the game.

name: Cannabis shatter
description: A brittle amber slab of cannabis extract on its parchment. Calms the nerves and dulls pain.
notes: One gram is one item, as with the tablet packs, so the row carries the reference's 0.5 g while drawing the slab on its opened parchment; CHECK VOLUME is that choice. fuel-amber stands in for the glassy extract.

name: Jar of cannabis wax
description: Soft yellow cannabis extract in a small glass jar. Calms the nerves and dulls pain.
notes: The jar stands open so the wax shows, and the jar sets it apart from the shatter's parchment. plastic-yellow stands in for the wax.

name: Tube of sugar pills
description: Tiny sweet pellets sold as a remedy. Does nothing.
notes: The name says what they are; the description stays plain. glass-clear stands in for the clear tube, so the pellets show only in the game.

name: Bottle of ibuprofen
description: An anti-inflammatory painkiller. Eases pain and swelling.
notes: The blue label and cap set it apart from the painkiller and acetaminophen bottles. The generic drug name is not a brand.

name: Vial of injectable iron
description: A vial of iron solution for injection. Helps rebuild lost blood. Needs a syringe.
notes: A liquid, so the item is the whole vial and the row carries the reference's 40 g. fuel-amber stands in for the dark yellow solution, seen through the glass in the game. Blood recovery and needing a syringe have no content fields yet.

name: Blister card of potassium iodide
description: Iodide tablets. Taken before radiation exposure, they shield the thyroid.
notes: The item id names the drug; the model id keeps the reference's. Round tablets come out blocky at 2 mm grain, the finest the lattice allows. Military and Police reflect emergency stockpiles. Radiation has no content field yet.

name: Joint
description: A cone of rolled cannabis with a card crutch. Calms the nerves and dulls pain. Needs a light.
notes: The model is the single joint, as a player finds and carries them one at a time, and its mass is the reference's 1 g. CHECK VOLUME is the carried-volume padding around a thin cone. The crutch at the narrow end sets it apart from the hand-rolled cigarette.

name: Bag of blotter tabs
description: Small squares of pink paper soaked with a hallucinogen. Brings on visions for hours.
notes: The tabs are 6 mm with 2 mm gaps so the perforations survive the 2 mm grain. There is no pink finish; plastic-clear-red stands in. glass-clear stands in for the bag.

name: Bottle of melatonin
description: A sleep supplement. Helps a tired body rest and recover.
notes: The antacid tablet shares this model as a variant, at 2 g a tablet; antacids also come in tall bottles. Sleep quality has no content field yet.
